sourceScope.actualReading: The English source is a historical edited version, not the complete 70-chapter French original. Chronological narrative runs in all 66 English chapters plus retained-scene checks support this condensed plot. Four French chapters resolve the coordinate, mistaken order and ending checks. No full French comparative collation is claimed.
